prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE square native FFXIV UTILITY/MENU-style hotbar icon for Steward, a Kaldigo collection-aware inventory manager. Reference image 1 is the current shared AutoRetainer/Steward bell logo, for the turquoise-to-magenta brand palette ONLY: create a DISTINCT STEWARD SYMBOL rather than another bell. Reference image 2 is the approved Aetherworks utility icon: match its restrained raised-enamel relief, modest bevel, quiet shading, clarity at 40px and SAME INDIGO background. Subject: a SIMPLE OPEN INVENTORY CRATE / storage tray with THREE broad square compartments or folded item blocks, and ONE bold CHECK MARK centered above or integrated into the front. A compact coherent utility emblem conveying collected inventory, not a shopping basket. Keep broad clean silhouettes, a maximum of three internal compartments and no tiny decorative details. Foreground horizontal palette: turquoise/teal #11D197 LEFT through cyan/violet to magenta #FF00FF RIGHT, just like the reference family. Background: perfectly quiet flat solid INDIGO #272640 from edge to edge and through negative spaces. Center foreground around 75 percent of the canvas with balanced margins; full-bleed square, no outer app frame, no rounded canvas corners (runtime adds them). No background gradient, texture, glow, aura, sparkles, rays, streaks, magical effects, text, numbers, watermark, coins, faces, extra tools or props. Must read as a clean native utility/menu icon rather than a combat action.
